notes.title: Road to an Alpha Build
notes.content: [h1]Road to an Alpha Build[/h1][p]We've been working to get an alpha build into the hands of players, but there are some things we're still working on before we release an alpha build.[/p][p]A general list will be provided here.[/p][p]The current to-do list:[/p][list][*][p]Removal of SCP: SL assets[/p][/*][*][p]Fixing many of the physics related bugs (Ragdoll lag, physics prop flying and exploits)[/p][/*][*][p]Updating some of the user interfaces[/p][/*][*][p]Finish the initial Light Containment Zone rooms[/p][/*][/list][h2]Future Plans[/h2][p]Everything here is subject to change, but is not something holding us back from an alpha build.[/p][p]This is also not a complete list.[/p][list][*][p]More Items (SCP-500, SCP-207)[/p][/*][*][p]More guns[/p][/*][*][p]Radios[/p][/*][*][p]Cuffs[/p][/*][*][p]Melee weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements and rewards[/p][/*][*][p]Server list filtering and tagging[/p][/*][/list][h2]Clips[/h2][p]Finally, here is a clip of a bug we found funny when testing physics props. Note that it has since been patched. (Thanks to closequarter for the clip)[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ogux5Nn42xw;full"][/previewyoutube]
